Today's update includes news on the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
Cyclone Akvan has reportedly missed the Chennai–Puducherry coast, bringing a sense of relief to the region. However, this brief respite is expected to be followed by a return of heavy rainfall. The India Meteorological Department, or IMD, has issued an update forecasting heavy rain for Tamil Nadu, including Chennai and coastal districts, as well as Puducherry and Kerala, for the next two days. This new spell of rain is attributed to easterly waves.
